name: Elastic Net Regression
learningObjectives: Understand how Elastic Net combines L1 and L2 regularization
Learn to balance feature selection and coefficient shrinkage
Master the l1_ratio parameter for controlling regularization mix
Apply Elastic Net to high-dimensional data with grouped features
Compare Elastic Net with Ridge and Lasso regression

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset to train on

controls.label: Alpha (Overall Regularization)
controls.tooltip: Controls overall regularization strength. Higher values increase both L1 and L2 penalties.

controls.label: L1 Ratio
controls.tooltip: Balance between L1 and L2 regularization. 0 = Ridge only, 1 = Lasso only, 0.5 = equal mix.

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the model learns.

visualizations.title: Data & Elastic Net Regression Line
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing the data points and the fitted regression line with combined L1/L2 regularization

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how the loss decreases during training

visualizations.title: Coefficients
visualizations.description: Bar chart showing coefficient values (some may be zero from L1, others shrunk by L2)

visualizations.title: Regularization Components
visualizations.description: Bar chart comparing L1 penalty, L2 penalty, and their combination

metrics.name: Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Average squared difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Root Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Square root of MSE, in the same units as the target

metrics.name: R² Score
metrics.description: Proportion of variance explained by the model

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Error
metrics.description: Average absolute difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: L1 Ratio
metrics.description: Balance between L1 and L2 regularization (0=Ridge, 1=Lasso)

metrics.name: L1 Norm of Weights
metrics.description: Sum of absolute values of coefficients

metrics.name: L2 Norm of Weights
metrics.description: Euclidean norm of the weight vector

metrics.name: Non-Zero Features
metrics.description: Number of features with non-zero coefficients
